title: Global AI Hackathon 2025
description: Build cutting-edge AI applications using large language models, computer vision, or multimodal AI. Open to developers worldwide with tracks covering LLMs, agents, AI safety, and generative media. Teams of 1–4 compete for $50,000 in prizes with special awards from sponsor companies.
shortDescription: Build the next generation of AI applications competing for $50K in prizes.

title: ETHGlobal Bangkok 2025
description: ETHGlobal Bangkok is a world-class Ethereum hackathon bringing together the brightest minds in Web3. Hack on DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, ZK proofs, and more with $120,000 in prizes and direct mentorship from top Ethereum core developers and protocol teams.
shortDescription: World-class Ethereum hackathon in Bangkok with $120K in prizes.

title: HackMIT 2025
description: HackMIT is one of the largest and most prestigious student hackathons in the world, held annually at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Over 1,000 hackers from universities around the globe build innovative projects across hardware, software, and social impact tracks over 24 hours.
shortDescription: MIT's flagship 24-hour hackathon for the world's brightest student hackers.

title: Climate Tech Hackathon 2025
description: Build solutions for the climate crisis. This hackathon challenges developers, scientists, and designers to create technology-driven solutions for carbon tracking, renewable energy optimization, sustainable agriculture, and climate resilience. Hybrid format — join in person or virtually.
shortDescription: Build tech solutions for the climate crisis — hybrid format, $25K in prizes.

title: Hack the North 2025
description: Canada's biggest hackathon, hosted at the University of Waterloo. Hack the North brings together 1,500 students from over 20 countries to build meaningful projects over 36 hours. Full travel reimbursement available for international hackers. Categories span everything from fintech to healthcare.
shortDescription: Canada's biggest hackathon — 1,500 students, 36 hours, travel reimbursements available.

title: HackIndia 2025 — National Finals
description: HackIndia is India's largest blockchain hackathon. The national finals bring together the top teams from regional rounds to compete for ₹20 lakh in prizes. Build on Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, or Aptos. Special prizes for teams solving real-world Indian infrastructure challenges using Web3.
shortDescription: India's biggest blockchain hackathon national finals — ₹20L in prizes.

title: GenAI Genesis
description: A 48-hour online hackathon focused entirely on generative AI applications. Build with the latest foundation models — text, image, video, audio, and multimodal. Tracks include productivity tools, creative applications, developer tools, and AI for accessibility. Prizes sponsored by Anthropic, Stability AI, and Replicate.
shortDescription: 48-hour online hackathon for generative AI apps — sponsored by Anthropic and Stability AI.

title: Solana Breakpoint Hackathon
description: Build the next generation of Solana applications at Breakpoint 2025. Compete across tracks including DeFi protocols, NFT infrastructure, consumer apps, payments, and developer tooling. Up to $200,000 in prizes from the Solana Foundation plus token grants from ecosystem projects.
shortDescription: Build on Solana at Breakpoint 2025 — $200K in prizes from the Solana Foundation.

title: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025
description: NASA's annual global hackathon connects coders, scientists, designers, storytellers, makers, builders, and technologists to use NASA's open data to build innovative solutions for challenges on Earth and in space. Over 35,000 participants from 160+ countries compete across local and global events.
shortDescription: NASA's global hackathon — 35K+ participants, 160+ countries, space tech challenges.

title: PennApps XXV
description: PennApps is America's first and one of the longest-running college hackathons, hosted by the University of Pennsylvania. PennApps XXV marks the 25th edition, bringing together 1,200 students to build for 36 hours. Tracks include fintech, healthcare, and open innovation with over $30K in prizes.
shortDescription: America's first college hackathon celebrates its 25th edition at UPenn.

title: DevFest Hackathon by Google
description: Build with Google technologies at the DevFest Hackathon. Use Gemini AI, Firebase, Google Cloud, Flutter, or Android to build apps that solve real-world problems. Open globally with regional judging and a global finals round. Best projects presented at DevFest 2025 events worldwide.
shortDescription: Build with Gemini AI, Firebase, or Flutter at Google's annual developer festival.

title: Meta Reality Labs XR Hackathon
description: Build immersive XR experiences for Meta Quest using Meta's XR SDK, Presence Platform, and Interaction SDK. Tracks include social VR, spatial computing, fitness, education, and enterprise. $75,000 in prizes plus potential for featured placement in the Meta Quest store.
shortDescription: Build Meta Quest XR apps — $75K in prizes and Quest Store featuring.

title: Smart India Hackathon 2025
description: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) is India's biggest open innovation model where students provide innovative tech solutions to India's pressing problems across education, agriculture, health, transportation, and digital governance. Organized by the Ministry of Education with ₹1 lakh per team prize.
shortDescription: India's largest government-backed hackathon — solve real national problems.

title: Buildspace Nights & Weekends S6
description: Buildspace's flagship 6-week program where builders ship something real in their nights and weekends. Over 40,000 builders have shipped projects in past seasons. Season 6 focuses on AI, consumer products, and developer tools. Culminates in a Demo Day in San Francisco with top builders.
shortDescription: 6-week program to ship your side project — 40K+ past builders, Demo Day in SF.

title: HackUPC 2025
description: HackUPC is the first and biggest student hackathon in Spain. Over the course of 36 hours, 800 students from all over the world come together in Barcelona to explore and combine technology in creative ways. Travel reimbursement available for European students. Prizes from Inditex, Vueling, and others.
shortDescription: Spain's biggest student hackathon — 800 hackers in Barcelona for 36 hours.

title: Junction 2025
description: Junction is Europe's leading hackathon, hosted in Helsinki, Finland. It brings together over 1,500 developers, designers, and innovators for a 48-hour sprint to build solutions across challenges set by global companies including Nokia, Wolt, and ABB. Travel grants available for international participants.
shortDescription: Europe's leading hackathon in Helsinki — 1,500 hackers, 48 hours, travel grants.

title: Chainlink Hackathon Fall 2025
description: Build hybrid smart contracts powered by Chainlink's decentralized oracle network. Use Chainlink Data Feeds, Automation, VRF, Functions, and CCIP to build DeFi protocols, on-chain gaming, NFT utilities, and cross-chain applications. $100K+ in prizes from the Chainlink ecosystem.
shortDescription: Build with Chainlink oracles — $100K+ in prizes for hybrid smart contracts.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2026
description: Microsoft's premier global student technology competition. Build solutions that tackle real-world challenges using Microsoft Azure, AI, and developer tools. Themes include earth, education, and humanitarian action. Regional winners advance to World Finals with $100,000 top prize.
shortDescription: Microsoft's global student tech competition — $100K World Finals prize.

title: TreeHacks 2025
description: TreeHacks is Stanford University's annual hackathon, bringing together 1,000+ hackers to build solutions with social impact over 36 hours. Focus areas include climate tech, health, and education with mentorship from Stanford faculty and Silicon Valley companies.
shortDescription: Stanford's flagship hackathon — 1,000+ hackers building for social impact.

title: Hack the Box University CTF 2025
description: HackTheBox's annual university Capture The Flag competition. Students form teams to solve cybersecurity challenges across web exploitation, reverse engineering, forensics, cryptography, and binary exploitation. Free to enter, open to all university students worldwide.
shortDescription: HackTheBox's annual university CTF — free, worldwide, for all security students.
